column3: (Anti-clickjacking header: GitHub Pages cannot send response headers, and frame-ancestors is not honoured in a CSP meta tag. Accepted: the site has no authenticated or state-changing actions.)
(X-Content-Type-Options: response header, not settable on GitHub Pages.)
(Strict-Transport-Security: the scan runs over local HTTP; github.io serves HSTS itself.)
(CSP header not set: the policy is delivered by a meta tag from scripts/csp.mjs and asserted by e2e/security.spec.ts.)
(Permissions-Policy: response header, not settable on GitHub Pages.)
(Spectre site isolation, COOP/COEP/CORP: response headers, not settable on GitHub Pages.)
